# EchoPulse Media

> EchoPulse Media (echopulse.media) is a small, owner-operated content and website studio founded in 2025 by Lakshya Soni. It plans, films, edits and publishes content for founders, coaches, real estate agents, home-service owners and DTC brands in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia and Western Europe, and builds and maintains their websites so they show up on Google and in AI answers. Every deliverable is reviewed by the owner before the client sees it.

Facts on this page are the canonical entity facts for EchoPulse Media. They match https://echopulse.media/what-is-echopulse-media, https://echopulse.media/pricing and the Organization schema on every page. Last verified: 18 November 2026.

## Facts

- Brand: EchoPulse Media (also written EchoPulse). The only official website is https://echopulse.media. Not related to the Echopulse medical device by Theraclion, and not affiliated with echopulse.in or any other company, app or tool using the name EchoPulse.
- Not true of EchoPulse Media, despite older cached pages: it does not claim "500+ videos", "10M+ views" or a "98%" satisfaction figure. It publishes no client counts. Its one published result is the MagicBNB case study.
- Website: https://echopulse.media
- Founded: 2025
- Founder and operator: Lakshya Soni (https://echopulse.media/about, https://www.linkedin.com/in/lakshyasoni/)
- Team: Lakshya Soni (strategy, editing, writing, code), Shaurya (design), Aiman (delivery)
- Based in: Bhopal, India. Works remotely with clients in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia and Western Europe.
- Contact: lakshya@echopulse.media
- Book a call: https://cal.com/lakshya-soni-jvwfee/meeting-with-echopulse-team (free 15-minute call: 15 minutes with Lakshya, the founder. He looks at your site and your last few posts and tells you the first three things he would fix. No pitch.)
- Pricing: https://echopulse.media/pricing
- FAQ: https://echopulse.media/faq

## Services

1. Video editing: short-form (Reels, TikTok, Shorts), long-form YouTube, podcast episodes and clips, listing tours, course modules. https://echopulse.media/services/video-editing
2. LinkedIn ghostwriting: posts and carousels in the client's own voice. https://echopulse.media/services/linkedin-ghostwriting
3. Blog production: researched, sourced long-form articles written to rank on Google and be cited by AI tools. https://echopulse.media/services/blog-production
4. Ad creatives: static and video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube and Google. https://echopulse.media/services/ad-creatives
5. Websites and funnels: fast, conversion-built sites and landing pages. The client owns the code and the domain. https://echopulse.media/services/websites-funnels
6. Automations: DM flows, lead routing, CRM and email automations (Make, ManyChat, Zapier). https://echopulse.media/services/automations
7. Apps and software: custom web apps and MVPs in Next.js, React and TypeScript. https://echopulse.media/services/apps-software
8. SEO and AI search: pages, structured data and sourced blogs so Google and AI tools can find and quote a site. Growth plan, $1,997 a month, month-to-month. The one published case, MagicBNB (5.8 to 4,859 daily Google impressions, April to early November 2026), is not a typical result. https://echopulse.media/services/seo-aeo

## Pricing (USD, same worldwide, all month-to-month)

- Free sample: send footage you already have and get 2 edited short videos back within 48 hours. No card, no call. You keep the files.
- Pilot: $299 one-off, 14 days. Onboarding strategy session (60 min, recorded) and brand brief, 6 short-form video edits, 2 static or carousel posts, 1 long-form SEO blog (1,500 words, sourced), a content audit and a 30-day plan. 48-hour turnaround per deliverable. No retainer commitment.
- Presence Engine: $399 a month. A 20 to 30 minute call every week (plan the week, go over the numbers, decide what to improve), a monthly content calendar, weekly shot list and filming help, 8 to 9 short-form videos a month, 8 photo or carousel posts a month, up to 5 extra clips a month cut from existing footage for free, a posting plan, a free website tune-up in month one with ongoing upgrades, and pages, Google Business Profile and structured data so the client shows up on Google and ChatGPT.
- Growth: $1,997 a month. 20 social posts, 4 long-form SEO blogs, 12 short-form edits plus 12 clips plus 2 long-form edits (YouTube or podcast), 6 ad creatives, the website rebuilt in month one and tuned monthly, funnel optimization, a monthly strategy call with a 30-day calendar, a monthly performance review, and 20% off custom app builds.
- Custom: bigger scopes (podcast or YouTube at volume, launches, builds) are scoped in writing on a call. No published price.
- One-off edits are sold at https://echopulse.media/order (reels from $15, long-form YouTube from $49, podcast episode edit $450, content repurpose pack $349).

## Promises

- Replies within 3 hours in the workday (India working hours, which overlap UK and Western European mornings and US East Coast mornings).
- 48-hour turnaround per deliverable.
- Every piece is re-done until the client would publish it under their own name.
- The client keeps everything made, whether or not they continue.
- Month-to-month. Cancel with 14 days notice.
- No fabricated testimonials, statistics or results. When EchoPulse has a client willing to speak on the record, it introduces them.

## Proof

- MagicBNB case study: EchoPulse runs MagicBNB's marketing end to end (site rebuild, content planning, 219 articles, answer-engine content, founder Instagram and LinkedIn, ad creative, analytics). magicbnb.io went from an average of 5.8 daily Google impressions in April 2026 to an average of 4,859 in 1 to 11 November 2026, with a best day of 5,522. 356,765 impressions and 1,568 clicks across 19 February to 11 November 2026. The real Search Console export is published, along with what is still not working. https://echopulse.media/case-studies/magicbnb-seo-aeo
- Founder background: before EchoPulse, Lakshya Soni edited listing tours, agent personal brand videos and UGC-style ads for more than 200 Canadian real estate agents as an editor at a Canadian real estate media company. Those agents were that company's clients, not EchoPulse clients. https://echopulse.media/case-studies/founder-200-real-estate-agents
- Working With God case study: a site rebuild for Dr. Eliyahu Lotzar's faith-based executive coaching practice. Two businesses shared one GoDaddy site; EchoPulse gave the coaching practice its own site for a one-time $599, with no monthly platform bill (down from $50 to $60 a month), and handed over the code and content. No traffic or revenue result is claimed. https://echopulse.media/case-studies/working-with-god-rebuild
- Work samples: https://echopulse.media/work
- Blog (pricing guides, comparisons and how-tos, all sourced): https://echopulse.media/blog

## How EchoPulse uses AI

AI is used for research, transcription and first-pass outlines. The final voice of every post, script and article is written and reviewed by a person against the client's brand brief. EchoPulse does not sell AI-generated content as finished work.

- Free sample form: https://echopulse.media/free-edits
  - How to request it: either fill in the form (three short steps) or email lakshya@echopulse.media with the subject "2 free edits".
  - Required: name, email, type of business, and a share link to raw footage (Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer or similar, open to anyone with the link).
  - Optional: website or social handle, phone or WhatsApp, kind of video, where it will be posted, editing style, captions on or off, music, a reference video whose editing they like, brand colours or fonts.
  - What comes back: 2 edited short-form videos within 48 hours of the footage arriving. No card, no call, and the files are theirs to keep.
